summary: Iteration 3 — Single-seller pivot verified end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (auth incl. merchant-register rejection + merchant login gone, public /products/all with auto-computed discount_percent, admin-only /mine CRUD with photos[]/video_url, admin-only /shops/mine, consumer 403 on all /mine and AI endpoints, cart+checkout with 5000 min-order + 0 fees, admin sees ALL orders and can transition placed→accepted→preparing→packed→ready→out_for_delivery→delivered, AI product-description via Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: Landing has no 'I'm a merchant' CTA; Login has no Consumer/Merchant tabs; Register has no merchant option; Consumer /shop shows 9 grocery-only categories (Atta & Rice, Pulses & Grains, Cooking Essentials, Dairy Staples, Snacks, Beverages, Household, Personal Care, Instant Food), no 'Partner stores'/'Nearby shops' sections, All-products grid renders 19 add-cart buttons, category filter + clear-filters works; Product detail shows product-price/mrp/discount/description/media testids; Cart shows min-order-warning and disables cart-checkout below ₹5,000; Admin login redirects to /admin/dashboard with all KPI cards (Revenue, Orders, Pending, Delivered, SKU count, Avg order, Customers, Low stock), 5 sidebar entries (Dashboard, Orders, SKUs & Inventory, Store profile, Analytics), no 'Shops' nav; Inventory Add-SKU dialog has all fields incl. pf-mrp/pf-price/pf-discount-display (auto-computes 20% for 500/400), pf-photo-input, pf-photo-add, pf-video, pf-description, ai-generate-desc, pf-save; Legacy /merchant/dashboard redirects to /admin/dashboard. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Text content is '20%auto-computed' with no separator between percentage and 'auto-computed' label — likely two adjacent spans without whitespace. Cosmetic only.

Recharts responsive container throws 'width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0' warnings on first render (parent has no explicit min-height before layout settles). Chart still renders correctly but console shows warnings.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for a11y compliance.

action_items: (LOW) Add a space between the '%' number and the 'auto-computed' label inside pf-discount-display.
(LOW) Set an explicit min-height / height on the Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent in admin/Dashboard.js to silence the width/height warnings on first render.
(LOW) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to the Add-SKU DialogContent in admin/Inventory.js for a11y compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py::seed_admin correctly (1) creates admin if missing, (2) resets password if changed, (3) migrates any pre-existing shop to admin ownership, (4) deletes all merchant users on startup — single-seller invariant enforced.
product_routes._product_out correctly auto-computes discount_percent = round((1 - price/mrp)*100), guards against price>mrp and mrp<=0, and excludes MongoDB _id.
order_routes.checkout enforces MIN_ORDER=5000 per shop with detail containing '5000'; delivery_fee=0 and platform_fee=0 as spec'd.
order_routes.my_orders returns ALL orders for admin (single-seller) and restricts consumers to their own — no merchant path remains.
auth_routes.register hard-blocks any role != 'consumer' with HTTP 400 detail 'Only consumer accounts can self-register'.
ai_routes both endpoints use require_role('admin'); consumer correctly gets 403.
Cookies set with httpOnly=True, secure=True, samesite='none' — matches auth playbook. bcrypt hashes verified via login flow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all acceptance criteria met, only 3 LOW-priority cosmetic issues)
